Unpopular opinion: Uncharted 2 beats Uncharted 4.

Uncharted 2 Nate is at his peak: funny, fast and never stuck in slow walking sections. Lazarevic was a simple villain who actually felt scary. Uncharted 4 is prettier. Uncharted 2 is more fun. Agree?
